mcp_connections.execution_required: Choose a workspace, at least one executor and a positive whole-number token ceiling.
mcp_connections.endpoints_help: One literal IP:port per line, up to 16. Host names and network ranges are not accepted. This does not grant general access to the local network.
mcp_connections.endpoints_required: Enter at least one specific IP address and port.
mcp_connections.media_tools: Allow media tools (spending needs a separate mission budget)
mcp_connections.media_local_help: These controls are available only in this desktop app. Media tools must also be allowed in the client’s execution grant.
mcp_connections.media_cli_help: Select your trusted Higgsfield CLI installation. Sign in through the CLI separately; do not paste credentials here.
mcp_connections.media_configured: CLI configuration saved. No generation was started.
mcp_connections.media_mission_help: Paste the exact mission ID returned by OmniGet. It must belong to the selected client.
mcp_connections.media_credits_help: Enter a positive amount up to 1,000,000 credits, with up to 6 decimal places. A dot or comma is accepted; thousands separators are not.
mcp_connections.media_budget_help: This replaces the mission’s total ceiling, including amounts already reserved. It does not add credits, release uncertain reservations, or submit a generation. Once authorized, the mission’s agent may spend within this ceiling.
mcp_connections.media_budget_invalid: Select an active client, enter an existing mission ID and a valid credit amount.
mcp_connections.media_budget_saved: Mission credit ceiling authorized. No generation was submitted by this form.
mcp_connections.gateway_write: Allow already granted write actions through the gateway
mcp_connections.gateway_write_help: Requires starting or controlling downloads, or creating or controlling missions. This does not add client scopes.
mcp_connections.gateway_transfer: Allow granted file transfers through the gateway
mcp_connections.gateway_transfer_help: Requires file transfer permission and its selected folder.
mcp_connections.gateway_help: Off by default for each new client. Requires macOS and the isolated worker helper. These options only record permissions; they do not start the gateway, publish a tunnel or demonstrate external connectivity.
